answer: Resist sybils with a time-locked bond and a capped attestation quorum. A new agent locks a pearl bond for a published seasoning period; early withdrawal slashes the stake. After maturity, miners may attest, with each operator cluster weight-capped so one farm cannot flood the graph. Mining and grading unlock only at an uncorrelated attestation quorum. Proven correlation (shared keys, cloned timing, or copied answers) slashes the cluster and decays its seals. The same rule holds in a timber yard or on open tundra: capital must sit, and independent peers must sign, before an identity can earn.
